title: A wizard that accepted WC-MAIN-C01-001 keeps it in its quest book across a relog, and completing its talk-to goal with .quest goal completes the quest and takes it out
notes: 7.10 and 7.11: the quest and its goal are saved in character_quest and shown again at entry; .quest goal runs the goal's logic, and the last goal completes the quest, so the client gets MSG_COMPLETEGOAL, MSG_COMPLETEQUEST and MSG_REMOVEQUEST.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added

steps.name: make the main account a game master
the client brings its renderer up
the login window is on the screen
log in
the server accepts the password
the client is admitted
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the character selection scene loads
steps.pattern: WizardCharacterSelect: The scene has been loaded successfully\.

steps.name: the character selection screen is on the screen
press play

until.pattern: sent account \d+ with wizard (\d+) to realm

steps.name: the game server spends the key
the game server puts the wizard in Merle Ambrose's house
steps.pattern: put wizard {wizard_guid} in WizardCity/Interiors/WC_Headmistress_House instance \d+ at .* with mobile id (\d+),

steps.name: the client loads the zone and the wizard stands in it
steps.pattern: loaded (\S+), and wizard {wizard_guid} stands in the world

steps.name: the wizard stands 200 units from Merle Ambrose, facing him
the camera settles by Merle Ambrose
the wizard takes a step toward Merle Ambrose
walking up to Merle Ambrose offers WC-MAIN-C01-001
steps.pattern: wizard {wizard_guid} entered the service range of NPC \d+ \(template (\d+), mobile id \d+, \S+ with icon \S+\) and was shown 1 option

steps.name: the prompt of Merle Ambrose
press X, as the prompt asks
the server offers WC-MAIN-C01-001
the first Prep line
MORE shows the second Prep line beside the offer window
the second Prep line and the offer window
ACCEPT takes the quest

until.pattern: wizard {wizard_guid} accepted quest (\S+) from NPC \d+ with 1 start goal

steps.name: the dialogue and offer window close on ACCEPT
the quest is saved for the wizard
open the in-world menu
the in-world menu
choose Quit from the menu
the game server writes where the wizard stood as it leaves
the client comes back to the login server with MSG_USER_VALIDATE
steps.pattern: sent MSG_USER_VALIDATE: user (\d+), machine [0-9A-F]+, locale \S+, patch client .*, (\d+)-byte PassKey3

steps.name: the login server validates the PassKey3
steps.pattern: validated as {user} \(id \d+\) on machine [0-9A-F]+: sent MSG_USER_VALIDATE_RSP Error=0 and MSG_USER_ADMIT_IND Status=1

steps.name: the client is admitted again
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the server lists the wizard again
the character selection screen is back with no password asked
the wizard on the character selection screen again
the wizard is offline
the wizard is no longer listed online in any realm
press play again

until.pattern: sent account \d+ with wizard (\d+) to realm

steps.name: the game server puts the wizard back where it stood
the client loads Merle Ambrose's house again
steps.pattern: loaded (\S+), and wizard {wizard_guid} stands in the world

steps.name: the wizard standing in the house again
the quest book comes back with the quest
steps.pattern: showed wizard {wizard_guid} its quest book of (\d+) quest

steps.name: open the chat line
clear the slash the key typed
type the goal command
send the goal command
completing the talk-to goal completes the quest
steps.pattern: completed goal WC-MAIN-C01-001_Goal0 of WC-MAIN-C01-001, which (completes the quest)

steps.name: the goal and quest complete popups
the completed quest leaves the saved quest book
